profile_text.body:
Runway describes itself as building foundational Real-World Intelligence that can understand, simulate and act in the world, with products and services built on top of that intelligence for individuals and organizations. The company was founded in 2018, is headquartered in New York, NY, USA, and is a for-profit startup.

Its site presents GWM-1 as a state-of-the-art General World Model that powers components including policy inference and evaluation and synthetic data generation, and says it will work with customers to fit those components to their hardware. It also describes Solaris as its first Interface World Model, real-time AI that generates interactive interfaces frame by frame with no code, and points to enterprise video generation as a focus area. The site's product listing tracks Runway under video generation and editing. Runway is hosting a Runway AI Summit on 9/30 in San Francisco, with speakers from DeepMind, NVIDIA and Physical Intelligence.

Court records name Runway AI, Inc. in four cases: David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc. in the District Court for the Southern District of New York and in the Central District of California, Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc. in the Southern District of New York, and Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc in the Southern District of New York. A fifth case, Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd., is in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. The company's litigation exposure is recorded in New York.
